description: Talk to your own Switch Agent, the same one on the Switch Agent page, without opening the app. It answers in its own words and works on your own account with its own tools: pictures, videos, sound, files, your library, your styles, your motion graphics, and reverse engineering a video with the pieces saved to your library. It finds your own styles, motion graphics, folders, voices and saved items by name. Pass back conversation_id to continue a conversation; leave it out to start a new one. A new conversation starts on Fable 5.2, then on whichever brain was last chosen with start_on: Fable 5.2, Astra 6.2, or BytePlus for work with faces or real people on accounts that have it. Every answer says which one it is on and lists the options. Long work keeps going after the answer returns; an empty message with the same conversation_id reads it, and the answer lists any task ids it started. A step that would spend tokens, delete something or post is not run: the answer carries pending_action with a link, and it runs only after your own tap in Switch. Talking to the agent uses your model time, the same as in the app.

asset_ids.description: Optional: ids of your own pictures or videos to hand to the agent with this message. Not needed when the item is named in the words.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from an earlier answer, to continue that conversation; leave out to start a new one.

message.description: What to say to your Switch Agent, in plain words. Empty (with conversation_id) to read a conversation that is still going.

start_on.description: Optional, for a new conversation only: fable (Fable 5.2, the first default), astra (Astra 6.2), or byteplus for work with faces or real people on accounts that have it. The choice is kept for the next new conversation. A continued conversation keeps its own.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for words before returning (5 to 55, default 45). If it is still working, call again with the same conversation_id.

title: Ask Switch Agent
